query:
INSERT INTO workflows (workspace_id, created_by, name, description, definition,
                                   webhook_token, enabled, next_run_at)
            VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, TRUE,
                    CASE WHEN $7::smallint[] IS NOT NULL
                         THEN workflow_next_run($7, $8, $9, NOW()) END)
            RETURNING id
